text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "La Section des affaires du Conseil fédéral traite les quelque 2'500 affaires que les départements soumettent annuellement au Conseil fédéral.", "gist": "The Federal Council Affairs Section handles around 2,500 cases submitted annually by departments to the Federal Council."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Elle traite en outre les quelque 1300 interventions parlementaires auxquelles le Conseil fédéral doit annuellement répondre.", "gist": "It also handles around 1,300 parliamentary interventions to which the Federal Council must respond annually."}]}
